---
title: "M0-05: pipster calculations only"
format: html
---

**Feature ID:** `decide-pipster-calculations-only`.

**Owner:** `pipsystem` design record. `pipster` owns calculations. `pipdata`
coordinates; `stamp` selects rebuild work and manages artifact versions.

**Git author:** R. Andres Castaneda. **Original recorder:** UNKNOWN.

## Decision

Keep calculations reusable by separating them from work selection and file I/O.
A separate layer selects estimates from a data list, supplies their inputs, and
saves their outputs through `stamp`. `pipster` does not choose what to run, read
files, or save results.

**Inputs:** Data supplied in memory to calculation functions.

**Outputs:** In-memory calculation results returned to the caller; the
coordinating layer handles storage separately.
